sections.title: New Features
items: Follow the optional Guide and read mobile What’s New, with explicit release-history refresh and offline notes.
Supported Wii custom-executable workflows offer cafe2wii and optional IOP2X patching. The finished title requires the supported c2w Aroma plugin and installation to Wii U system memory.

sections.title: Improvements
items: Use Android’s system picker for inputs and finished ZIP export.
Simple/Advanced workflows and supported online content options remain available.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Corrected Wii Trim preparation for supported custom-executable and cafe2wii workflows.
